query:
insert into TestCaseVerifiedRequirements (
                        collect_nr,
                        product_id,
                        test_run_name,
                        test_run_date,
                        test_case_name,
                        req_collect_nr,
                        req_id
                    )
                    select
                        $1,
                        $2,
                        $3,
                        $4,
                        $5,
                        r.collect_nr,
                        $6
                    from Requirements r
                    where r.collect_nr = (
                        select max(cr.collect_nr)
                        from Requirements cr
                        where cr.product_id = r.product_id
                    )
                    and r.product_id = $2
                    and r.id = $6
